gotchas: Reebok US is a Shopify store (cdn.shopify.com scripts) on its own domain, so host detection by *.myshopify.com does not match; this recipe names the platform.
Guest path: /search?q=… -> product -> button[name="add"] -> /cart -> button[name="checkout"] -> Shopify one-page checkout. No account prompt.
On load the search page shows a cookie banner and an SMS-offer popup inside an iframe ('Dismiss this popup'); dismiss it before clicking products.

One-page checkout: contact email, delivery address (input[name=firstName|lastName|address1|city|postalCode|phone], select[name=zone], select[name=countryCode]) and the payment section with Shopify card-fields iframes (number, expiry, verification, name) are all on screen at once. Two sets of name/address inputs are visible (delivery and billing); scope fills to the first (delivery) set.
Card frames and #checkout-pay-button were confirmed present read-only on 2026-10-06; nothing was filled, so the recipe is unverified.
Through the proxy from a US tunnel on 2026-10-06 no bot wall or challenge appeared.

2026-10-09 (staging proxy, egress outside the US): a SpiceGems country-redirect modal (#sg_country_redirect_mod) covers every page and intercepts clicks; click its 'No' link (#sg_country_redirect_mod a:has-text("No")) after each navigation.
